stories.title: 'I don't know who No. 3 is, but holy s---': Every NFL team's biggest training camp riser of all time
stories.summary: Let's look back to when 32 NFL players kick-started their careers with strong performances in training camp and the preseason -- one from each team.

stories.title: Romo placed on leave by CBS after OWI arrest
stories.summary: CBS Sports has placed NFL analyst Tony Romo on leave following his arrest last week on suspicion of driving under the influence.

stories.title: Packers star TE Kraft (ACL) activated off PUP
stories.summary: Packers star tight end Tucker Kraft was activated off the physically unable to perform list Friday, less than nine months after surgery to repair the torn ACL in his right knee.

stories.title: Mets start dealing, trade reliever Minter to Twins
stories.summary: The last-place Mets, in what could be the first of multiple deals, have traded left-handed relief pitcher A.J. Minter to the Twins for prospects Bruin Agbayani and Billy Amick.

stories.title: Deebo back to 49ers on 1-year deal, sources say
stories.summary: Free agent Deebo Samuel is signing back with the 49ers on a 1-year deal that could be worth up to $7 million, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
